name: Habakkuk
description: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see.

note.label: Habakkuk 1: O Lord, How Long Shall I Cry

points: When you read Habakkuk it is talking about Babylon and the Chaldeans. One of the first empires, under Nimrod, was Babylon. Yes, it occurred under Nebuchadnezzar, but it is twofold, because it is also talking about the daughter of Babylon.
